findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_dpp_requirements, validate_gs1_identifier, build_gs1_digital_link, get_techpack_template, create_data_carrier · Private data: validate_dpp_document, draft_dpp_document, create_data_carrier · Public sink: estimate_textile_impact, validate_techpack, create_dpp, publish_product_passports · Destructive: validate_dpp_document.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_dpp_requirements, validate_gs1_identifier, build_gs1_digital_link, get_techpack_template, create_data_carrier · Private data: validate_dpp_document, draft_dpp_document, create_data_carrier · Public sink: estimate_textile_impact, validate_techpack, create_dpp, publish_product_passports · Destructive: validate_dpp_document

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "draft_dpp_document" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
